name: Razorhide
summary: In Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers Razorhide to those who bring him blood shards. The captive quilboar trades Agamaggan’s life essence for a blessing that hardens the skin before battle.

sections.title: Blessings of the Boar God
sections.body: The quilboar trace their power to Agamaggan, the Great Boar who died fighting the Burning Legion thousands of years ago. His blood sank into the Barrens and hardened into crystalline shards, still alive with ancient power. The Horde and quilboar remain sworn enemies, yet Mangletooth, held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, will share sacred knowledge for these fragments.

sections.title: Hardening the Hide
sections.body: Quilboar are born with thick hides and protective quills, but their warriors call on Agamaggan to harden their skin against blades and claws. Mangletooth can perform the rite for outsiders, channeling four blood shards to strengthen their defenses and help keep their bones unbroken in the wilds.

faq.answer: Mangletooth, an imprisoned quilboar in a wooden cage at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, offers the Razorhide ritual. Once you show you know how to handle blood shards, he trades blessings for more.
Blood shards are crystals found across the Barrens. Quilboar believe they formed from Agamaggan’s spilled blood during the War of the Ancients and still hold great primal magic.

faq.q: Why is an imprisoned quilboar helping Horde travelers?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is held captive by the tauren at Camp Taurajo. He keeps his rough manner and loyalty to Agamaggan, but his hunger for blood shards leads him to teach outsiders quilboar rites.

faq.q: What kind of protection does Razorhide represent?
faq.answer: Razorhide is a quilboar warding called upon before battle. It hardens the skin and strengthens the bones with Agamaggan’s supernatural endurance.

faq.q: Can you receive Razorhide more than once?
aliases: how many times can i do razorhide
faq.answer: Yes. Mangletooth can invoke Razorhide again whenever you bring him four blood shards.

faq.q: Where can blood shards be found?
faq.answer: Blood shards can be scavenged from geomancers, hunters, and warriors in quilboar encampments, brambles, and crags throughout the Barrens.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the hunters of Camp Taurajo watch Mangletooth’s cage closely. Quilboar rites touch sacred Earthmother ground, but their feral practitioners rarely share secrets without a price.
As a warrior, you benefit from magical armor and a hardened hide when you enter the dangerous thorn thickets of the southern Barrens.
As a member of the Horde, you find Camp Taurajo holding ground against quilboar encroachment. Mangletooth’s reverence for Agamaggan gives travelers a way to draw on his rites.
